main: Tired of bland boiled chicken breast? This Air Fryer Chicken Yulinji recipe transforms it into a juicy, flavorful dish that makes you forget it's diet-friendly. The magic is in the easy, vibrant sauce, turning simple chicken into a restaurant-quality meal without deep-frying.
reply1:
For 1-2 servings:
• 2 chicken breasts (soak in milk 10 min, pat dry, rub with olive oil, salt, pepper)
• Sauce: Mix soy sauce 2, vinegar 1.5, water 1, sugar (or allulose) 1. Add 1 tbsp each minced scallion, Cheongyang chili, garlic.
reply2: Air fry chicken at 180°C for 10 min, flip, then 5 min. Slice chicken over lettuce, then pour over the sauce. Chill the sauce in the fridge before serving for authentic Yulinji flavor.
alt_text: Sliced juicy chicken breast over shredded lettuce with glossy soy vinegar sauce and chopped scallions and chili, Chinese Yulinji style, on a white plate, in appetizing warm light.
